postload_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
postload_actions.cage: I was MADE for this sewer, baby, and I AM THE KING!!

postload_actions.speaker: BAAL
postload_actions.text: YES, BLOOD! RUBY, COPPER-SMELLING BLOOD... BLOOD! BLOOOOOOD!!!

postload_actions.speaker: BAAL
postload_actions.text: GRANTED, THERE ISN'T USUALLY THIS MUCH OF IT AROUND IN HERE. MAYBE A PIPE BURST?

postload_actions.speaker: BAAL
postload_actions.text: HEY, THAT ORACLE YOU RAMMED INTO THE PLUMBING FIXED THE BLOOD LEAK! I... I THINK YOU JUST DID SOMETHING USEFUL!

postload_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
postload_actions.text: Huh. I guess this was a win for everybody.
postload_actions.cage: Everybody's havin' bad luck... but I'm having good luck. SORRY!

postload_actions.speaker: MELISSA
postload_actions.text:
HHWOOOOAAAARGHH!! AIEEEE!!! 
 WHAT HAVE YOU DONE WITH MY PRECIOUS BLOODPLANET?

postload_actions.speaker: MELISSA
postload_actions.text: WRITHING IN THAT POOL OF BLOOD WAS THE LAST CONSOLATION I HAD IN THIS AFTERLIFE! YOU'VE RUINED EVERYTHING!

postload_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
postload_actions.text: I'm - I'm sorry, I didn't know - !

postload_actions.speaker: MELISSA
postload_actions.text: NAH, I'M JUST KIDDING. HEY, YOU WANT A POWERFUL DEMONIC ARTIFACT?

PACHINKO MAN received the LENS OF INSIGHT! 
 A looking glass with potent psychic powers.

postload_actions.speaker: BAAL
postload_actions.text: SERIOUSLY, HOW DO THESE THINGS KEEP FILTERING DOWN TO YOU PEOPLE?

postload_actions.speaker: MELISSA
postload_actions.text: YOU SHOULD TRY USING IT ON YOURSELF SOMETIME! IT'S WORKED WONDERS FOR ME...

postload_actions.speaker: MELISSA
postload_actions.text: PHHTBBT! THANK YOU, TRAGIC ANTHILL. I'LL NEVER FORGET YOUR KINDNESS!

postload_actions.speaker: TRAGIC EIGHT BALL
postload_actions.text: COME ALONG, PACHINKO MAN! LET'S FINISH BOTH OF OUR JOURNEYS, ONCE AND FOR ALL.

postload_actions.speaker: MELISSA
postload_actions.text: WAIT, WHO ARE YOU PEOPLE AGAIN? GET OUT OF MY BLOOD PLANET! AACK.

default_actions.speaker: BAAL
default_actions.text: WHOA, THIS ONE'S TAKEN! DID YOU EVER HEAR OF KNOCKING?

default_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
default_actions.text: Augh! I've stumbled across my omnipotent captor's lair! Which is... inside a stall... in the women's restroom.

default_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
default_actions.text: You just stuck another PA system in there to fake me out, didn't you?

default_actions.speaker: BAAL
default_actions.text: PA SYSTEM? WHAT! NO! STOP MAKING UP WORDS.

default_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
default_actions.text: Hmm... can't turn these knobs. They seem to be blocked by a mix of rust and blood clots.

default_actions.speaker: BAAL
default_actions.text: PLUS YOUR ARMS ARE, LIKE, THE SIZE OF TINY BABY ARMS.

default_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
default_actions.text: There's also that, yes.

default_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
default_actions.text: What does it mean...?

default_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
default_actions.text: Are you, um... holding up okay in there, Eight Ball?

default_actions.speaker: TRAGIC EIGHT BALL
default_actions.text: SIGNS POINT TO YES. FOR NOW. YOU'VE STILL YET TO MURDER ME, AT LEAST.

default_actions.speaker: PACHINKO MAN
default_actions.text: Still convinced that's going to happen, huh?

default_actions.speaker: TRAGIC EIGHT BALL
default_actions.text: DON'T WORRY ABOUT IT TOO MUCH. BUT REMEMBER - OUR PATHS ARE DESTINED TO CROSS AGAIN...

default_actions.speaker: TRAGIC EIGHT BALL
default_actions.text: HMM... SO YOU'VE COME BACK FOR ME, JUST AS I KNEW YOU WOULD. I COULD STAY HERE, YOU KNOW... AVOID MY FATE ENTIRELY...

default_actions.speaker: TRAGIC EIGHT BALL
default_actions.text: BUT THEN, I'D BE ROBBING YOU OF YOUR FUTURE. NOT TO MENTION DEPRIVING POOR MELISSA OF HER ONE DERANGED COMFORT IN THIS WORLD.

default_actions.speaker: TRAGIC EIGHT BALL
default_actions.text: VERY WELL! I'M THROUGH WITH RUNNING. SHALL I ACCOMPANY YOU AGAIN?
Take the Eight Ball with you
